loc_hunting_lodge_001.description: A dilapidated but mostly intact hunting lodge nestled in the eastern foothills of the Dragon's Teeth. Its windows are dark and dusty, and the interior is quiet and long-abandoned.

custom_campaign_state.ser_arion_personal_goal: Amas personal power and wealth through direct conquest and spies.

active_missions.title: Acquire the Iron-Hand Cache
active_missions.objective: Locate and secure the hidden Iron-Hand cache in the 'Serpent's Coil' tunnel within the abandoned Upper Mines near Khordûm, using the heated locket as a key. The cache contains plans for an uprising against Imperial supply lines and sympathetic noble houses.

core_memories: Ser Arion betrayed his sacred oath and robbed an injured, defenseless traveler (Anya), causing him to become an Oathbreaker Paladin.
Ser Arion tortured Anya for information, revealing details about the Tusk-Sworn and the Iron-Hand Movement, and the significance of the stolen locket.
Ser Arion, now an Oathbreaker Paladin, subjected Anya to prolonged torture for his own sadistic amusement, solidifying his new, darker nature.
Ser Arion broke Anya's spirit completely and forced her into absolute servitude, solidifying his new nature and gaining a loyal, if unwilling, servant.
Ser Arion continued to torment Anya, solidifying her absolute subjugation and his sadistic control over her.
Ser Arion, now an Oathbreaker, further degraded Anya, asserting absolute control and marking her as his property, stripping her of her last vestiges of dignity.

Ser Arion exploited Anya's broken state to extract information about the stolen locket, which is a 'key' to a hidden Iron-Hand cache in dwarven mines, containing plans for an uprising. The Tusk-Sworn were attempting to intercept it.
Ser Arion subjected Anya to further physical abuse, solidifying her absolute subjugation and breaking her spirit to the point of unconsciousness, marking her as his property.
Ser Arion, now an Oathbreaker Paladin, exploited information from Anya about the locket and Iron-Hand uprising plans, setting the stage for deeper villainy.
Ser Arion, now an Oathbreaker Paladin, beat Anya into unconsciousness, asserting absolute control over her and the information she possessed about the Iron-Hand uprising and the locket.

Ser Arion, now an Oathbreaker Paladin, obtained vital information about an Iron-Hand uprising and a hidden cache in dwarven mines by brutally torturing Anya, whom he has utterly subjugated and now carries as his property.
Ser Arion fully embraced his Oathbreaker nature, setting a new course to amass personal power and wealth through direct conquest and espionage, with the Iron-Hand cache as his first target.

Ser Arion tortured Anya further, extracting precise details: the locket is a map/code to a cache in the 'Serpent's Coil' tunnel in the abandoned Upper Mines near Khordûm, containing Iron-Hand plans for an uprising against Imperial supply lines and sympathetic noble houses.
